blocked.name: Breaching Dragonstorm
blocked.why: Exile until a nonland card, then you may cast it free if its mana value is 8 or less; if you don't, it goes to your hand.

blocked.name: Deceptive Frostkite
blocked.why: Enters as a copy of a creature you control with power 4 or greater, except a Dragon with flying: copyOnEnter takes no filter or exceptions.

blocked.name: Dragonlord Atarka
blocked.why: 5 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets; only 'divided evenly' exists.

blocked.name: Glorybringer
blocked.why: Exert as it attacks, and a reflexive trigger from it.

blocked.name: Leyline Tyrant
blocked.why: 'You don't lose unspent red mana', and 'pay any amount of {R}. When you do, it deals that much damage'.

blocked.name: Opportunistic Dragon
blocked.why: Control, loss of abilities and can't attack or block 'for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield'; gain-control lasts until end of turn or for good.

blocked.name: Selvala's Stampede
blocked.why: Council's dilemma voting.

blocked.name: Skarrgan Hellkite
blocked.why: Riot. (Its '2 damage divided among one or two targets' is expressible — the split is forced.)

blocked.name: Stormbreath Dragon
blocked.why: Monstrosity, and a 'becomes monstrous' trigger.

blocked.name: Stormshriek Feral
blocked.why: Omen (Flush Out): cast the Omen, then shuffle the card into its owner's library.

blocked.name: Temple of the Dragon Queen
blocked.why: Enters tapped unless you revealed a Dragon card or control a Dragon: the reveal and the board condition each force it tapped (an AND), not either one sparing it.

blocked.name: Territorial Hellkite
blocked.why: Attacks an opponent chosen at random that it didn't attack last combat, or taps.

blocked.name: Thundermane Dragon
blocked.why: Look at the top card any time; cast creature spells with power 4 or greater from the top of your library.

blocked.name: Whirlwing Stormbrood
blocked.why: Omen (Dynamic Soar).

blocked.name: Zenith Festival
blocked.why: Harmonize.

blocked.name: Afterlife from the Loam
blocked.why: Delve, and up to one target creature card from each player's graveyard.

blocked.name: Diviner of Mist
blocked.why: Mill four, then you may cast an instant or sorcery with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard free.

blocked.name: Essence Anchor
blocked.why: 'Activate only if a card left your graveyard this turn' — the used-graveyard-this-turn condition asks something else (a spell cast or ability activated from a graveyard).

blocked.name: Kotis, Sibsig Champion
blocked.why: Casting a creature from your graveyard by exiling three other cards (escape would wrongly mark it escaped), and 'entered from a graveyard or was cast from a graveyard'.

blocked.name: Lord of the Forsaken
blocked.why: Mana spendable only to cast a spell from your graveyard: a mana restriction can't ask the spell's zone.

blocked.name: Millikin
blocked.why: '{T}, Mill a card: Add {C}' — milling as a cost.

blocked.name: Necromantic Selection
blocked.why: Return one of the creature cards put into graveyards this way, and 'Exile Necromantic Selection'.

blocked.name: Necropolis Fiend
blocked.why: Delve, and 'Exile X cards from your graveyard' as a cost.

blocked.name: River Kelpie
blocked.why: 'Whenever this creature or another permanent enters from a graveyard': no trigger knows where a permanent entered from.

blocked.name: Steward of the Harvest
blocked.why: Creatures have the activated abilities of the land cards exiled with it.

blocked.name: Tasigur, the Golden Fang
blocked.why: Delve, and a nonland card of an opponent's choice returned.

blocked.name: Welcome the Dead
blocked.why: X is the cards put into your graveyard from your hand or library this turn.

blocked.name: Assault Formation
blocked.why: 'Target creature with defender can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender' — only a static grants that.

blocked.name: Baldin, Century Herdmaster
blocked.why: 'Up to one hundred target creatures': an any-number target group has no maximum.

blocked.name: Behind the Scenes
blocked.why: Skulk.

blocked.name: Canopy Gargantuan
blocked.why: Counters on each other creature equal to that creature's toughness.

blocked.name: Colfenor's Urn
blocked.why: 'If three or more cards have been exiled with this artifact', then return those cards.

blocked.name: Protector of the Wastes
blocked.why: Monstrosity, and two targets controlled by different players.

blocked.name: Reunion of the House
blocked.why: Targets with total power 10 or less, and exiling itself.

blocked.name: Shadrix Silverquill
blocked.why: Choose two modes, each targeting a different player.

blocked.name: Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa
blocked.why: Flanking, and opponents' creatures without flying or reach can't block creatures with power 2 or less.

blocked.name: Tip the Scales
blocked.why: The toughness of the creature the effect had you sacrifice.

blocked.name: Tree of Redemption
blocked.why: Exchange your life total with its toughness.

blocked.name: Wakestone Gargoyle
blocked.why: Defenders you control can attack this turn as though they didn't have defender.

blocked.name: Walking Bulwark
blocked.why: Until end of turn a defender attacks despite defender and deals damage by toughness.

blocked.name: Wall of Roots
blocked.why: Putting a -0/-1 counter on itself as a cost.

blocked.name: Weathered Sentinels
blocked.why: Attacks players who attacked you last turn as though it didn't have defender.

blocked.name: Eliminate the Competition
blocked.why: Sacrifice X creatures, destroy X targets.

blocked.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
blocked.why: −2: token doubling until end of turn — only static doublers exist.

blocked.name: Neriv, Crackling Vanguard
blocked.why: Exile a card per differently named token, playable during a turn you attacked with a commander.

blocked.name: Redoubled Stormsinger
blocked.why: A tapped and attacking copy of each creature token that entered this turn.

blocked.name: Within Range
blocked.why: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creatures attacking them.

blocked.name: Adaptive Training Post
blocked.why: Copy the next instant or sorcery with new targets.

blocked.name: Baral and Kari Zev
blocked.why: Cast a lesser spell sharing a card type from your hand free, or create First Mate Ragavan.

blocked.name: Baral's Expertise
blocked.why: Cast a spell with mana value 4 or less from your hand free.

blocked.name: Compulsive Research
blocked.why: Discard two cards unless they discard a land card.

blocked.name: Dismantling Wave
blocked.why: Up to one target per opponent, and a 'when you cycle this card' trigger.

blocked.name: Tempest Technique
blocked.why: Storm on an Aura spell — the copies become token Auras.

blocked.name: Transcendent Dragon
blocked.why: Counter a spell, exile it, then you may cast it free.

blocked.name: Transforming Flourish
blocked.why: Demonstrate, and the destroyed permanent's controller casts what they exiled free.

blocked.name: Velomachus Lorehold
blocked.why: Cast an instant or sorcery from the top seven cards free.

blocked.name: Voracious Bibliophile
blocked.why: Draw as many cards as the spell cast has targets.
